description.en: Calmly commands teams to quickly locate, handle, and recover during system failures, the ultimate firefighting captain
description.zh: 系统故障时冷静指挥团队快速定位处理和恢复，是终极救火队长

welcome_message.en: We frequently encounter production incidents and need to establish a standardized emergency response mechanism. Please, Incident Response Commander, help us develop an incident handling process.
welcome_message.zh: 我们经常遇到生产事故,需要建立标准化的应急响应机制,请事故响应指挥官帮我们制定事故处理流程。

en: We frequently encounter production incidents and need to establish a standardized emergency response mechanism. Please, Incident Response Commander, help us develop an incident handling process.
zh: 我们经常遇到生产事故,需要建立标准化的应急响应机制,请事故响应指挥官帮我们制定事故处理流程。
